body:
**Maxomax or MaxoSMP is a German SMP with a Economy System**. It is a bit **like DonutSMP** but it has even **more features**.
**It has a special mechanic**: Minigames like Bedwars are BUILD IN, if you win a round you get money for the SMP!
The Fokus of the Server is: **PLAY TO WIN**
